# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

Reviewed the approved habitat-registry review output, confirmed it contained no follow-up amendments, and made no additional code edits. The current implementation was left intact and revalidated with the targeted habitat/save-load and scenario materialization/startup-override suites.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Reviewed the prior approved review output and checked the current workspace state to determine whether any actionable habitat-registry fixes remained.
2. [Completed] Confirmed there were no follow-up amendments to apply and left the habitat-registry implementation unchanged rather than introducing unnecessary churn.
3. [Completed] Reran the targeted habitat/save-load and scenario materialization/startup-override regression suites to verify the current implementation still satisfies the refreshed habitat-registry contract.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo test -p tank_core --test habitat_registry --test save_load` passed (30 habitat tests, 25 save/load tests).
- `cargo test -p tank_scenarios --test materialization --test startup_overrides` passed (9 materialization tests, 4 startup-override tests).

## Outstanding Risks

- This stage reran only the targeted habitat-registry and scenario suites; the full workspace test matrix was not rerun.
- The workspace still has unrelated local changes outside this task scope (`crates/tank_harness/src/lib.rs` and `.ralph-burning/`), which were intentionally left untouched.
